name: hotfix
description: Production hotfix: reproduce, smallest repair, strict tests, fast review, mandatory approval.

stages.title: Confirm incident scope and safe reproduction
stages.instruction: Confirm the failure mode and blast radius. Establish a safe reproducer or concrete evidence. Identify rollback option before editing.

stages.title: Implement minimal hotfix
stages.instruction: Make the smallest change that resolves the confirmed production defect. Avoid opportunistic refactors.
